structure: Revised once: retain the primary mixture law and marginal calibrations, but replace the assumed middle-band copula correlation with deterministic calibration to the additional CHNS geometric-mean ratio. Independent people receive paired continuous measurements. Calibration uses population integrals, never realized sample moments.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Band probabilities, depletion probabilities, Hb means and SDs, ferritin geometric means and geometric SDs
parameter_provenance.use: Primary quantitative calibration; rounded summaries are treated as population values.

Calibrates the middle-band Gaussian copula correlation through conditional mean log ferritin above versus below Hb 13. The reported bootstrap interval 1.061–1.398 describes evidence uncertainty but is not sampled as person-level variation.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Low- and high-Hb copula correlations 0.50 and 0.05
parameter_provenance.source: Author assumptions, qualitatively informed by Zhu et al. Table III
parameter_provenance.use: Retain stronger positive dependence at low Hb and weak dependence at high Hb. These numerical correlations are not reported study estimates.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Bounded-power Hb and two-slope lognormal ferritin families
parameter_provenance.use: Match band moments and depletion probabilities with positive continuous measurements.

parameter_provenance.source: Zhu et al., separate Hebei population
parameter_provenance.use: Qualitative support for positive, severity-dependent association only. Neither its marginal levels nor its adjusted OR is pooled with CHNS.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of Hb <12 among ferritin <15 divided by the corresponding odds among ferritin >=15.
requested_estimands.population_implication: The calibrated population table implies (123*710)/(83*207), approximately 5.083. Generated sample estimates fluctuate.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation of ranks of continuous, uncorrected Hb and ferritin on the same generated people.
requested_estimands.population_implication: Determined by between-band differences and within-band copulas. The additional aggregate constrains middle-band dependence but does not identify the overall rank correlation.

limitations: Most consequential remaining assumption: dependence within the low- and high-Hb bands follows the nominated copulas. This remains unidentified by the available aggregates and materially affects Spearman correlation without changing the calibrated crude OR.
Transport to other CHNS-design communities assumes the same joint population law. Community heterogeneity, clustering, aggregate-estimation uncertainty, and transport uncertainty are not simulated.
The cohort represents complete-case women aged 18–49 regardless of pregnancy or inflammation. No weighting, inflammation correction, altitude adjustment, or pregnancy exclusion is introduced.
Tail shapes are planning assumptions. Hb has approximate support 7.6–20.7 g/dL, and ferritin tail behavior is not established by the supplied summaries.
checks_actually_performed: Checked count consistency: band counts total 1,123 and depleted counts total 330; the upper bands reproduce 207 depleted and 710 nondepleted women.
Calculated the evidence-community crude OR as approximately 5.083.
Reviewed the supplied generated-only checks for the previous law: threshold-cell fractions differed from A by at most approximately 0.00135, with band summaries close to their calibration values.
Analytically checked that changing the middle-band copula preserves all calibrated band marginal distributions and threshold-cell probabilities.

The revised calibration equates the conditional mean-log-ferritin difference to log(1.215), using the analytic conditional expectation of the piecewise-linear Gaussian transformation and deterministic quadrature.
No revised-code execution or revised generated-cohort checks were performed in this interface.
